title: A shrinking square store written with content-address products
summary: A square store is multiplied by a fixed constant below one at every symbol and then receives the product of the symbol's content vector and its address vector. A probe vector is multiplied into the store to read out a sum of earlier contents, each weighted by its address match and by how long ago it was written.
core_idea: Multiply a square store by a fixed constant below one per symbol, add the content-address product of the symbol, and read by multiplying the store with a probe vector.

state.name: S
state.meaning: Square store: the sum of earlier content-address products, each shrunk by the constant gamma once per later symbol.

update.name: projections
update.latex: k_t = W_k e_t,\; u_t = W_u e_t
update.plain: address k_t = W_k e_t and content u_t = W_u e_t, where e_t = E[x_t] is the embedding of symbol x_t

update.name: store
update.plain: S_t = gamma * S_(t-1) + outer(u_t, k_t), where gamma in (0, 1) is a fixed decay constant

readout.name: read
readout.latex: y_t = S_t q_t,\; q_t = W_q e_t
readout.plain: y_t = S_t q_t with the probe q_t = W_q e_t

readout.name: symbol
readout.plain: next symbol scores O y_t over the V symbols

learning.description: Every matrix and offset is learned by gradient descent on the cross-entropy of the next symbol over a training corpus, with backpropagation through the whole sequence. The constant gamma is fixed before training (gamma = 0.97).
learning.few_shot_argument: No structure for few examples; the card states 4000 training sequences for recall of 4 pairs.

complexity.constants_notes: One scaling and one rank-one write of a d by d store and one d by d product per symbol, plus the output map.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Gradient descent with no structure for few examples.

prediction.statement: From random weights, 4000 training sequences of 4 pairs over 16 symbols give recall accuracy 0.99.

capabilities.prediction: Exact recall with hand-set orthogonal addresses when K <= d and the shrink factor gamma^K stays above the readout margin.
A pair written L symbols before its probe contributes with weight gamma^L, so retention falls off geometrically with distance.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: A pair written 200 symbols before its probe is recalled as well as a pair written 2 symbols before it, at gamma = 0.97.
The counted operations grow faster than linearly in n at fixed d and V.

toy_example.description: Three writes into a two by two store with gamma = 0.5 and one probe.
